newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Dec weekly earnings rise 2.7 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Canada Dec weekly earnings rise 2.7 pct on year.

text.p: The preliminary estimate of average weekly earnings for Canadian workers in all industries except agriculture and fishing rose 2.7 percent in December from a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted C$593.82, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.
From the month before, earnings rose 0.2 percent.
Seasonally adjusted payroll employment rose 0.9 percent in December to 11.14 million from an upwardly revised 11.04 million in November.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that average weekly earnings would rise by 3.0 percent, year on year, after a 3.1 percent rise in November.
